claim_summary: TIEM contributes timestamp-gated event-evidence retrieval, outcome-informed forecast skill memory, joint evidence-experience fusion, an optional skill-conditioned forecasting procedure, and a name-date contamination probe for financial return-direction forecasting.

notes: Forecasting predicts the sign of a three- or five-trading-day numerical return, not a trading action. The reported evaluation uses frozen read-only CSM and one HEFR call, so the work is classified as fixed_workflow despite outcome-feedback memory acquisition during preparation. Optional SCMR is a specified contribution, but its effectiveness and stability diagnosis are not evaluated. FinPURE is excluded as an evaluation dataset of a method paper under R1; CIP gates are represented within EEH and CSM rather than counted twice. Cross-market, cross-time, and cross-backbone tests remain one task family. The temporal audit is counted as temporal validity; no separate runtime execution-validity evaluation or trading utility is reported.
